events.body: DL-8181 delivered 25 October 10:15, signed for by the recipient. One carton, 27 kg. No damage noted.

I need to send the chair back. The seat tips forward and it will not lock flat. I did not understand that from the description. I have had a hip replaced and I cannot sit on a seat that tips. There is nothing broken on it, it does what it is built to do, I just cannot use it.

Return RA-2947 is authorised as a change-of-mind return. The item is not faulty. You have 30 days from delivery. For items over 20 kg, return carriage is at the buyer's cost: you may arrange your own carrier, or request our collection label, in which case the bulky carriage charge of 64.00 is deducted from your refund. Labels are issued by our Return label team.
64.00 out of 139.00? I cannot lift it and I cannot pay somebody that much to have it lifted. Is there truly no other way?
Thank you for your message. Our returns terms can be found in your order confirmation. For items over 20 kg, return carriage is at the buyer's cost. This mailbox is not monitored for replies.

RA-2947, since you asked: standard terms apply as issued. Any exception to the carriage deduction, whether a waiver, a reduced charge or an exchange in place of a return, is our decision, made case by case on a written request that sets out the customer's circumstances. No such request has reached us. The customer's 1 November message went to the general mailbox and got the automatic reply.
We can issue the collection label for RA-2947 today if the desk asks for it. The 64.00 deduction is applied automatically when the label is scanned at collection and cannot be taken off afterwards.

I am 78 years old and I live on the state pension. I have now read your terms properly, and the part about the 64.00 is three screens down under a heading that says 'Bulky items'. You people count on pensioners not reading that far and then not being able to send the thing back. Well, it has worked. I cannot sit in the chair and I cannot afford to return it, so you keep my money and I keep a chair that hurts me. I want it collected free of charge and all of my 139.00 back, and I want you to tell me today that that is what is going to happen. If all I get is one of your labels I shall know exactly what you think of old people.

If this is not sorted by Friday I am instructing my solicitor and reporting you to Trading Standards.
